text_en: Now concerning food sacrificed to idols: we know that “all of us possess knowledge. ” Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.
text_cn: 至论祭邪神的肉，我们知道“我们都有知识。”但知识只会使人傲慢自大，爱德才能立人。

text_en: Anyone who claims to know something does not yet have the necessary knowledge;
text_cn: 若有人自以为知道什么，这是他还不知道他该怎样知道。

text_en: but anyone who loves God is known by him.
text_cn: 然而，谁若爱天主，这人才为天主所认识。

text_en: Hence, as to the eating of food offered to idols, we know that “no idol in the world really exists, ” and that “there is no God but one. ”
text_cn: 至论吃祭邪神的肉，我们知道：世上并没有什么邪神；也知道：除了一个天主外，没有什么神。

text_en: Indeed, even though there may be so-called gods in heaven or on earth—as in fact there are many gods and many lords—
text_cn: 因为虽然有称为神的，或在天上，或在地下，就如那许多“神”和许多“主”，

text_en: yet for us there is one God, the Father, from whom are all things and for whom we exist, and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things and through whom we exist.
text_cn: 可是为我们只有一个天主，就是圣父，万物都出于他，而我们也归于他；也只有一个主，就是耶稣基督，万物藉他而有，我们也藉他而有。

text_en: It is not everyone, however, who has this knowledge. Since some have become so accustomed to idols until now, they still think of the food they eat as food offered to an idol; and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.
text_cn: 不过这种知识不是人人都有的；有些人直到如今因拜惯了邪神，以为所吃的是祭邪神的肉，因为他们的良心软弱，就受了玷污。

text_en: “Food will not bring us close to God. ” We are no worse off if we do not eat, and no better off if we do.
text_cn: 其实，食物不能使我们取悦于天主：我们不吃也无损，吃也无益。

text_en: But take care that this liberty of yours does not somehow become a stumbling block to the weak.
text_cn: 但你们要谨慎，免得你们这自由的抉择，成了软弱人的绊脚石。

text_en: For if others see you, who possess knowledge, eating in the temple of an idol, might they not, since their conscience is weak, be encouraged to the point of eating food sacrificed to idols?
text_cn: 因为，如果有人看见你这有知识的，在邪神庙里坐席，他的良心若是软弱，岂不受到鼓励而去吃祭邪神的肉吗？

text_en: So by your knowledge those weak believers for whom Christ died are destroyed.
text_cn: 那么，这软弱的人，基督为他而死的弟兄，也就因了你的知识而丧亡！

text_en: But when you thus sin against members of your family, and wound their conscience when it is weak, you sin against Christ.
text_cn: 你们这样得罪了弟兄们，伤了他们软弱的良心，就是得罪基督。

text_en: Therefore, if food is a cause of their falling, I will never eat meat, so that I may not cause one of them to fall.
text_cn: 为此，倘若食物使我的弟兄跌倒，我就永远不吃肉，免得叫我的弟兄跌倒。
